Section C405.2.1 Occupant Sensor Control: Add: Section C405.2.1.3 Specific Application Controls.
For the construction of new hotels:

column2: Each hotel guest room shall be equipped with a master control device that automatically turns off the power to all lighting fixtures in the guest room no more than 30 minutes after the room has been vacated; and

A master control device may also control the heating, ventilation, or air conditioning default settings in hotel guest rooms 30 minutes after a room has been vacated by: (1) Increasing the set temperature by at least 3° F. when in the heating mode.
